timestamp: Time when the flow was recorded.
src_ip: IP address of the device that started the flow.
src_port: Source port number used by the sender.
dst_port: Destination port number used by the receiver.
protocol: Transport-layer protocol, such as TCP, UDP, or ICMP.
packets_count: Total number of packets in the flow.
fwd_packets_count: Number of packets sent from source to destination.
bwd_packets_count: Number of packets sent from destination back to source.
total_payload_bytes: Total payload bytes carried in the flow.
fwd_total_payload_bytes: Payload bytes carried in the forward direction.
bwd_total_payload_bytes: Payload bytes carried in the backward direction.
payload_bytes_max: Largest payload size observed in any packet.
payload_bytes_min: Smallest payload size observed in any packet.
fwd_payload_bytes_max: Maximum payload size in the forward direction.
fwd_payload_bytes_min: Minimum payload size in the forward direction.
fwd_payload_bytes_std: Standard deviation of forward payload sizes.
bwd_payload_bytes_max: Maximum payload size in the backward direction.
bwd_payload_bytes_min: Minimum payload size in the backward direction.
bwd_payload_bytes_std: Standard deviation of backward payload sizes.
total_header_bytes: Total bytes used by all packet headers in the flow.
max_header_bytes: Largest header size among all packets.
min_header_bytes: Smallest header size among all packets.
fwd_total_header_bytes: Total header bytes in the forward direction.
fwd_std_header_bytes: Standard deviation of forward header sizes.
bwd_total_header_bytes: Total header bytes in the backward direction.
bwd_std_header_bytes: Standard deviation of backward header sizes.
fwd_avg_segment_size: Average data segment size in the forward direction.
bwd_avg_segment_size: Average data segment size in the backward direction.
avg_segment_size: Overall average segment size for the flow.
fwd_init_win_bytes: Initial TCP window size advertised by the sender.
bwd_init_win_bytes: Initial TCP window size advertised by the receiver.
active_min: Shortest active period before the flow became idle.
active_max: Longest active period before the flow became idle.
idle_min: Shortest idle period before activity resumed.
idle_max: Longest idle period before activity resumed.
bytes_rate: Bytes per second for the whole flow.
packets_rate: Packets per second for the flow.
down_up_rate: Ratio of download/backward traffic to upload/forward traffic.
avg_fwd_bytes_per_bulk: Average bytes transferred in a forward bulk transfer.
avg_fwd_packets_per_bulk: Average number of packets in a forward bulk transfer.
avg_fwd_bulk_rate: Average byte rate during forward bulk transfers.
avg_bwd_bytes_per_bulk: Average bytes transferred in a backward bulk transfer.
avg_bwd_packets_bulk_rate: Average packet rate during backward bulk transfers.
avg_bwd_bulk_rate: Average byte rate during backward bulk transfers.
fwd_bulk_state_count: Number of forward bulk states observed.
fwd_bulk_total_size: Total bytes sent in forward bulk transfers.
fwd_bulk_per_packet: Average bytes per packet within forward bulk transfers.
fwd_bulk_duration: Total time spent in forward bulk states.
bwd_bulk_state_count: Number of backward bulk states observed.
bwd_bulk_total_size: Total bytes sent in backward bulk transfers.
bwd_bulk_per_packet: Average bytes per packet within backward bulk transfers.
bwd_bulk_duration: Total time spent in backward bulk states.
fin_flag_counts: Number of packets with the FIN flag set.
psh_flag_counts: Number of packets with the PSH flag set.
urg_flag_counts: Number of packets with the URG flag set.
ece_flag_counts: Number of packets with the ECE flag set.
syn_flag_counts: Number of packets with the SYN flag set.
ack_flag_counts: Number of packets with the ACK flag set.
cwr_flag_counts: Number of packets with the CWR flag set.
rst_flag_counts: Number of packets with the RST flag set.
fwd_fin_flag_counts: Forward packets with the FIN flag set.
fwd_psh_flag_counts: Forward packets with the PSH flag set.
fwd_urg_flag_counts: Forward packets with the URG flag set.
fwd_ece_flag_counts: Forward packets with the ECE flag set.
fwd_syn_flag_counts: Forward packets with the SYN flag set.
fwd_ack_flag_counts: Forward packets with the ACK flag set.
fwd_cwr_flag_counts: Forward packets with the CWR flag set.
fwd_rst_flag_counts: Forward packets with the RST flag set.
bwd_fin_flag_counts: Backward packets with the FIN flag set.
bwd_psh_flag_counts: Backward packets with the PSH flag set.
bwd_urg_flag_counts: Backward packets with the URG flag set.
bwd_ece_flag_counts: Backward packets with the ECE flag set.
bwd_syn_flag_counts: Backward packets with the SYN flag set.
bwd_ack_flag_counts: Backward packets with the ACK flag set.
bwd_cwr_flag_counts: Backward packets with the CWR flag set.
bwd_rst_flag_counts: Backward packets with the RST flag set.
packets_IAT_mean: Average time between consecutive packets in the flow.
packet_IAT_std: Standard deviation of packet inter-arrival times.
packet_IAT_total: Total of all packet inter-arrival times.
fwd_packets_IAT_std: Standard deviation of forward packet inter-arrival times.
bwd_packets_IAT_std: Standard deviation of backward packet inter-arrival times.
subflow_fwd_packets: Average number of packets in a forward sub-flow.
subflow_bwd_packets: Average number of packets in a backward sub-flow.
subflow_fwd_bytes: Average bytes carried in a forward sub-flow.
subflow_bwd_bytes: Average bytes carried in a backward sub-flow.
